_readme: PVill demo organizations, part 3. Adds to sample-data.json (KAN-26) and demo-families.json; changes nothing in them.
EVERYTHING in this file is made up. No real organization or address. Websites and emails use .example.
Street addresses are fictional. ZIP codes are real Nashville ZIPs so distance and ranking work.
Both organizations are Verified when loaded. Pickup dates are relative, as in sample-data.json.
